q1.question: How can I earn rewards?
q1.answer: You can earn rewards by completing surveys, special offers, and referral bonuses on Profit Piller.

q2.question: How do I qualify for surveys?
q2.answer: Each survey has targeting criteria. Completing your profile honestly improves your chances of qualifying for more surveys.

q3.question: Why are there no surveys available?
q3.answer: Survey availability depends on your profile and current demand from our partners. Make sure your profile is complete and try again later.

q4.question: What is a screen-out?
q4.answer: A screen-out occurs when your responses don't match the target audience for a survey. You won't receive full credit, but it helps us match you better next time.

q5.question: Why did I not receive the full reward for the survey?
q5.answer: Some surveys offer partial rewards for partial completions or disqualifications. Always ensure accurate answers and a stable internet connection.

q6.question: Can I use a VPN or Proxy to take surveys?
q6.answer: No. Using VPNs or proxies is strictly prohibited and may result in account suspension or disqualification from surveys.

q7.question: When can I redeem my rewards?
q7.answer: Once you reach the minimum threshold (e.g., $425), you can redeem instantly via PayPal, gift cards, or other available methods.

q8.question: Can I refer others and earn bonuses?
q8.answer: Yes! Share your referral link. You’ll earn a 10% commission on what your referrals earn from surveys — for life!

q9.question: Is my data safe with Profit Piller?
q9.answer: Yes, your data is secured with strict privacy protocols and is never shared without your consent.

q10.question: How do I contact support?
q10.answer: Reach us anytime at support@profitpiller.com or through the contact form in your dashboard.
